## E — Market signal

Status: no market research was performed for this section; the upstream competitive-intelligence pointer was not supplied for this run, so market size, pass rate, rooms, voice-of-customer quotes, persona, seasonality, price and success bar are recorded as typed debt (verify — MD-SEC-SIX-E-MARKET).
Known context only from the product frame: buyers are first-time Maryland applicants and the parents of teen drivers preparing for the MVA knowledge test.
Section angle: line-marking passing rules are a classic trick-question area, so the market pass should check whether learners ask for road-view drills on solid versus broken lines.
Ad hooks, verbatim learner pain phrases and a named differentiation gap must come from sourced recon in a later pass, never invented here.
